title: Bounds for the Vertex Chromatic Number of Connected Triangle-Free Graphs
summary: It was recently shown that every connected graph of order $n \geq 5$ and size $m$ satisfies $χ(G) \leq \left\lceil \frac{m}{\sqrt{n}} \right\rceil$, and it was asked whether the stronger inequality $χ(G) \leq \left\lceil \frac{m}{2\sqrt{n}} \right\rceil + 1$ holds for every connected triangle-free graph. In this paper, we answer this question in the affirmative. In fact, we prove that every connected triangle-free graph $G$ with $G \not\cong C_5$ satisfies $χ(G) \leq \left\lceil \frac{m}{\sqrt{5.5n}} \right\rceil + 1$, where the constant $\sqrt{5.5}$ cannot be replaced by any constant…
